title: Brown adjunction for ordinary etale compact-support towers
statement:
Fix distinct primes $p,\ell$, a field $k$ of characteristic $p$, and a $k$-morphism $f:X\to Y$ between separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Fix a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, valuation ring $R$, uniformizer $t$, and $A_n=R/t^n$ for $n\ge1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Choose a compactification $c=(X\xrightarrow{j}\overline X\xrightarrow{g}Y)$, with $j$ open and $g$ proper [def-weil-compactifications-refinements].

For $T=X,\overline X,Y$, let $\mathsf S_T^{\mathrm{et}}$ and $\mathsf S_T^{\mathrm{proet}}$ be the abelian categories of strict systems of $(A_n)_T$-module sheaves on the indicated small sites, with semilinear quotient transitions and componentwise exactness; use their ordinary unbounded derived categories and exact evaluations $e_n$ [lem-pur-coefficient-system-derived-comparison]. Put $F^{\mathrm{et}}=Rg_{*,\bullet}^{\mathrm{et}}j_{!,\bullet}^{\mathrm{et}}$ and $F_n^{\mathrm{et}}=Rg_{*,n}^{\mathrm{et}}j_{!,n}^{\mathrm{et}}$. Then $\mathsf S_T^{\mathrm{et}}$ is Grothendieck abelian; coproducts of derived systems are represented by termwise sums, and the evaluations preserve coproducts and jointly detect isomorphisms. The canonical comparisons $e_nF^{\mathrm{et}}\cong F_n^{\mathrm{et}}e_n$ hold on the whole unbounded derived category and respect the quotient transitions. The functor $F^{\mathrm{et}}$ is exact, $R$-linear and preserves arbitrary small coproducts. It consequently has an ordinary exact Brown right adjoint $G^{\mathrm{et}}$, with actual unit and counit in the derived categories of systems [lem-grothendieck-derived-brown-right-adjoint]. Give $G^{\mathrm{et}}$ the scalar action obtained by transposing scalar multiplication through $F^{\mathrm{et}}$; then its adjunction bijections are $R$-linear. This assertion is on ordinary etale tower categories and does not assert an unbounded pro-etale exceptional adjoint.

source.place: Tag 0F5Y, proposition-brown, with the agent-formulated application to ordinary etale strict coefficient towers; returned item proof Step 3.

proof.text: The valuation-ring theorem gives that the given generator t of the coefficient maximal ideal is nonzero in the domain R, so multiplication by t is injective. The completeness proof coefficientIntegers_complete in AdicLimitFiniteModules identifies the valuation-ring topology with the maximal-ideal adic topology. Rewrite by the stated generator equality to get t-adic completeness. The residue field is finite by the DVR theorem, and Ideal.finite_quotient_pow gives finiteness of every positive quotient R/(t^(n+1)).

Apply the coherent compact-support construction with O=R and this t. Retain its actual strict-system compact-support functor, derived evaluations, open restriction comparison, inverse-image mate equation and open transition equation. These data concern only the geometric construction and do not include a Brown adjoint, scalar linearity or coproduct preservation.

At each of X, Z and Y use the explicit equivalence from strict coefficient systems to strict systems over the quotient-ring sheaves. Transport the strict-system Grothendieck assertion and ordinary coproducts. The derived coproduct theorem proves that Q preserves the sheaf-universe coproducts. Exact evaluation preserves them termwise and hence on derived categories; compare to the package evaluation by its localization factorization. Joint detection follows from the coefficient evaluation comparison proved by exact cohomology and cones. Install the recorded standard HasDerivedCategory instances explicitly, since alternative equivalent localization models need not be definitionally equal.

Both ordinary inverse-image system functors are additive and exact. Identify their recorded unbounded derived inverse images with the exact mapDerivedCategory lifts via their representative factorization and localization uniqueness (the private exactDerivedIso construction). Give these lifts their standard shift and triangulated structures and transport them across this isomorphism. The open left adjoint and proper right adjoint then inherit additive, shift-compatible triangulated structures from their exact adjoints. Their composite is the required exact compact-support functor. This does not need a separate right-derived-triangulated-functor theorem.

The target Y is locally Noetherian and quasi-compact because it is finite type over Spec of a field. Properness of g makes Z locally Noetherian and quasi-compact as well. For each finite quotient coefficient ring, transport the proper direct-image coproduct theorem to the normalized ringed-site derived level. Open extension preserves coproducts because it is a left adjoint. Thus the level compact-support composites preserve coproducts. The evaluation comparisons give preservation after each evaluation of the system functor. Use joint reflection of isomorphisms to jointly reflect the colimit cocone; its images are colimit cocones because the level composites and evaluations preserve coproducts. This includes empty coproducts.

Paste the proper direct-image transition equation with the open transition equation. First distribute restriction over the composite evaluation map. Rewrite the proper transition equation, then move the open evaluation through the restricted proper direct-image comparison by its naturality. Apply the proper-level functor to the open transition equation. Functoriality and associativity give exactly the required compact-support transition equation.

Brown representability is stated for a Grothendieck derived category with Hom universe equal to the sheaf universe; our standard derived models live in a larger universe. Choose the Grothendieck-sized derived localizations and use exact identity functors to induce equivalences between the small and the recorded standard localizations. Conjugate compact support by these equivalences. Coproduct preservation and triangulatedness pass through the equivalences, so grothendieckDerived_hasRightAdjoint applies. Cancel the equivalences using isLeftAdjoint_comp_iff_left and isLeftAdjoint_comp_iff_right to obtain an actual adjunction on the original recorded derived categories.

Choose the actual right adjoint and adjunction from IsLeftAdjoint. Transfer additivity, the canonical shift comparison and triangulatedness from compact support to this right adjoint by adjunction. Retain the supplied normalized coefficient scalar actions and compact-support preservation equation.

For central scalar natural transformations s and t with F(s_K)=t_(FK), homEquiv naturality in its left input gives Phi(t_(FK) followed by a)=s_K followed by Phi(a). Applying this to the counit and using Phi(counit)=identity gives the required scalarTranspose equation. Naturality of the counit and centrality of t, followed by injectivity of the inverse homEquiv, gives G(t_L)=s_(GL). Finally homAddEquiv_add supplies additivity of each homEquiv. Assemble these facts and the preceding constructions into EtaleTowerBrownAdjunction without changing any existing statement.
